scope: web-lite-playable; scoped visual regression and readability, not premium-art approval
reviewer: ChatGPT visual inspection of downloaded original PNGs and lossless-layout contact sheets; not an external human tester
observations: Reviewed four natural roof/tower joins at both gameplay viewport sizes. No obvious full opaque transition panel, empty vertical strip or displaced full-image seam mask was observed in these eight captures.
All four rides have distinguishable in-world silhouettes and matching visible control prompts/timers in both gameplay viewports. They are code-rendered shapes, not a finished illustration set.
Phone startup, cashout, selected character and restored next-run screens remain legible. The opaque growth panel no longer shows underlying settlement text.
At 568x320, the three tabs and Return remain inside the panel; only the content scrolls. Not every content row is simultaneously visible.
Portrait guard covers the menu and displays the rotation instruction without underlying menu controls leaking through.
limitations: Only bound captures were visually reviewed; no claim covers every seed, every pixel in motion, every device or all long runs.
State-observing automated input is not blind human playtesting and does not prove retention or revenue.
Vehicle/obstacle geometric art still differs from the illustrated backgrounds; character ability wording and art unification remain polish work.
Physical phone performance, platform packages, real ads and commercial release remain unverified.
